data.why: the repository already ships a complete example exhibit (exhibit.json, data/images tile pyramid, assets/visdata) that index.html loads by default, so no files need to be copied or written

goals: pan and zoom through a multiplexed tissue image at full resolution
toggle individual channels on and off to compare marker expression
follow narrative waypoints that highlight and describe specific regions of interest
inspect per-cell or per-region data overlays tied to the image

review.summary: The tree captures Minerva Story's core uses well: deep zoom, channel groups and per-channel editing, the narrated waypoints, the H&E lens and arrow-based share links. The labels and features are mostly well cut, and the evidence is mostly sound. A few nodes overclaim or cite the wrong screen (inline link, clone), the lens and clone tasks sit in the wrong phases, and region/box sharing is missing, so it needs a short round of fixes before filing.
